# LORPlusModManager v1.0.1

## Added

- Choose where imported mods are stored from Settings → Storage & maintenance.
- Confirmation before changing the library location. Existing mods are moved, and synced mods are unsynced.
- Progress reporting during library moves, including the current stage and file.

## Fixed

- Fixed import failures for some ZIP mods containing Unity AssetBundles with incorrect size headers.

Existing libraries continue using the default storage location unless you choose another folder.
